tasks.short: Preserve investigation video and interview notes

steps.what: Collect video and notes of interviews

tasks.design: The investigation program is opened from {DOCS}. Collecting video and notes of interviews, and preserving surveillance material, stay with the security manager. The index stores sealed item ids only. It does not interpret the video.
tasks.previous_blocker: Tapes and notes were boxed with no index of what was sealed.
tasks.enabler_now: A sealed item can be given an id once the manager has preserved it.
tasks.still_hard: Collection, interviews, and the decision to preserve stay in person.
tasks.human_edge: The manager knows a note that must not be copied.
tasks.altitude: Sealed items have ids. The video is not watched by a model, and it is not a finding.

reach.task: Request a sealed item by id
reach.learn: The index is not the content

evidence.claim: An index of sealed ids is a record. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Interpreting surveillance of people is not a configuration task.

The source pack names a rule that a significant decision about a person is not taken by automation alone, and that hiring, appraisal, or staff monitoring needs works-council consent. Other countries differ.

assumptions: The work starts when an investigation program is open and ends when the manager indexes what was sealed.
An item id is assigned by the manager after preservation. The store holds the id, the date, and the location. It does not hold a description generated from the video.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Where video is kept, and who may unseal it.
research_questions: Does workplace surveillance already have works-council consent?

already_counted.description: Collection time is already in the collection step.

incremental.description: Correct an index line if the seal location changes.

approvals.approved_version: item ids the manager sealed for that program

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when programs are not filed. Video is not interpreted. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Total losses and violations from the log
Draft internal investigations reports from totals

loop.purpose: Draft an investigations report that cites only logged losses and violations.
loop.input: Loss id or violation id, with its amount or type.
loop.output: Report lines that each cite one stored id.
loop.check: Every figure cites a stored id, and no violation is added.
loop.stop: Stop when the log for the period is empty.
loop.why_not_simpler: A slide template cannot show which log row a figure came from.

tasks.design: Losses and violations are totaled from the log on {BI}. A draft report cites only those rows. The security manager reviews the presentation against regulations, policies, and procedures. A total is not a finding about a person.
tasks.previous_blocker: Investigation decks were rebuilt from the log by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: Loss and violation rows can be totaled for a period.
tasks.still_hard: What the presentation should say, and whether it matches the rules, stays a review.
tasks.human_edge: The manager stops a line the log does not support.

ambition.what: A corrected loss can refresh the draft the same week, and a row that is not logged is not presented.

tasks.altitude: The week is the review of the presentation, not the addition.

evidence.claim: Totals of stored loss rows are deterministic. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. The presentation is still reviewed.

assumptions: The work starts when an investigations report is due and ends when the manager issues it.
A loss has an id and an amount. A violation has an id and a type. Both are produced by the investigation log. A person is not named by the total.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether losses and violations are separate rows with ids.
research_questions: Who may see a report that could identify a person?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the presentation is already in the review step.

incremental.description: Retire a report when a logged amount changes.

approvals.approved_version: report the manager reviewed for that period

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when losses are not logged as rows. The review stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Attend seminars and note changes to operations

steps.what: List seminars and filed directive changes
Note changes that affect security operations

tasks.design: Seminars and filed directive changes are listed from {CALENDAR} and {DOCS}. Attending professional conferences stays in person. The security manager notes which changes affect security operations. A listed seminar is not a finding.
tasks.previous_blocker: Directives arrived as mail, and the useful point was lost after the conference.
tasks.enabler_now: A seminar date and a filed directive can be listed.
tasks.still_hard: Being there, and judging what changes the operation, stays the manager's.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears a limit the directive text does not state.
tasks.altitude: The list is ready before the trip. The judgement of what changed is written after it.

reach.learn: Which directive was judged not to apply

evidence.claim: The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Attending a seminar is not replaced by a summary of its title.

assumptions: The work starts when a seminar is booked or a directive is filed and ends when the manager notes the effect on operations.
A seminar has a date and a title. A directive has an id and a text, produced by the person who filed it. A directive that is not filed is not summarised.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether legislative directives are filed as documents.
research_questions: Which seminars the firm expects the manager to attend?

already_counted.description: Attendance is already in the conference step.

incremental.description: Amend a note if the directive text is replaced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when directives are not filed. Attendance stays in person. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Choose and order security supplies and technology

steps.what: List supplies and equipment below reorder
Choose the security technology to purchase

tasks.design: Supplies and equipment below reorder are listed from {PROCUREMENT}. The security manager chooses the technology to purchase. The order is placed only for that choice.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reorder points lived in a side list, and orders were retyped.
tasks.enabler_now: Stock rows can show what is below a reorder point.
tasks.still_hard: Which technology to buy, and from whom, stays a choice.
tasks.human_edge: The manager rejects a quote that does not fit the site.
tasks.altitude: The reorder list is current. The choice stays with the manager, and only that choice is ordered.

evidence.claim: A reorder list is configuration. The source pack says security work in this group is ticket and incident-log configuration, and that the judgement stays with a person. Placing the order waits for the choice.

assumptions: The work starts when stock is below its reorder point and ends when the approved order is placed.
A stock row has an item id, a quantity, and a reorder point, produced by the store. A quote has a supplier id and a price. An item with no quote is not ordered.
Time a system already spends running is not counted as the security manager's effort.
A draft that cites an identifier which is not in the store is discarded.
The incremental hours retire stale drafts when source rows change.
unknowns: Whether security items have reorder points in the purchasing record.
research_questions: What spend can the manager release without a second person?

already_counted.description: Choosing the technology is already in the choice step.

incremental.description: Cancel an order if the quote is withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: items and supplier the manager chose

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Saving falls when reorder points are not stored. The choice stays. The range is below that case.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Investigation video is preserved by the manager and is not interpreted. Reports total only logged losses. Seminars are attended. A purchase is chosen before the order is sent.
reach: Counsel can ask for a sealed id, not a generated description.
A supplier receives only the chosen order.
skills_to_grow: Do not describe a video the manager has not sealed.
Do not present a loss that is not logged.
role.ambitious_version: A corrected loss refreshes the report the same week, and the previous total is not what is issued.
